recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. If HL7 wants the visible published pages corrected, update the publication/site-maintenance process or static release artifacts that control hl7.org/fhir/R4 and hl7.org/fhir/R5 headers, then republish or patch those pages outside this core source reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-34247 is a Published/Persuasive technical correction asking that the yellow published-version header on all resource pages use "its permanent home" instead of "it's permanent home". It was raised against R4, applied for R5, and cites the R4 Observation page as an example of the FHIR-core-many surface.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged source application was found in the current core checkout. Historical git shows the old WebSiteReleaseUpdater template introduced with the typo in 0432f8145982b08d3e3e2a673af8cd6c5445d26a and deleted in ba096263615784cdef548fd62c10ba25623c995d before this Jira was created; the current tree no longer contains that updater or any replacement release-header prose source.
additional_context: The live hl7.org R4 and R5 Observation pages still contain "it's permanent home", while the current build.fhir.org Observation page has no release header. Current core source searches found only publish-box CSS selectors in tools/html/fhir-pub.css, not the header text. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no related decision that changes this ownership conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No source files were changed because the remaining defect is on static published release pages or publication/site-maintenance tooling outside this active FHIR core source checkout.
